ينعطف (form VII)

# يُنْعَطَفُ (yunʕaṭafu) /jun.ʕa.tˤa.fu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْعَطَفَ (inʕaṭafa)
# يَنْعَطِفَ (yanʕaṭifa) /jan.ʕa.tˤi.fa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَطَفَ (inʕaṭafa)
# ي
